notes.title: Pizza Slice - Steam Playtest incoming!
notes.content:
Ciao wannabe Pizza Managers!


We’re setting up a limited access, closed playtest for Pizza Slice - our upcoming cozy simulator in which you run a pizza restaurant business. The test is scheduled to last from August 26th until September 16th. To join, simply go to Pizza Slice’s Steam Store Page and click the green “Request Access” button to be viable for participation.



It’s 100% free with the only requirement being able to run the game (that is being above the minimal system requirements). 

Here’s the latest trailer for the game, enjoy![previewyoutube="5d_Os2XN0uk;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]

🍕About Pizza Slice


If you’ve been dreaming of running an Italian restaurant with traditions right out of a cozy depiction of New York city, then you’re in for a treat! Pizza Slice is more than just a simulator, it is a true Italian adventure! Take on the role of Tonio, manage your family pizzeria, bake authentic Italian pizzas, fight the competition and grow your business. See if you can win the title of the best pizzeria in the area!
Game features:[p align="justify"]• The Dream - Experience a cozy Italy in the heart of a romanticized New York City: run an Italian pizzeria in the middle of a bustling American metropolis. • The Business - owning a restaurant is not only about the food, but also managing ingredients, doing prep work, cleaning, and being the front face of the establishment. In Pizza Slice you need to master the whole business of running a restaurant, not only the food.

• The Buzz - you need to think on your feet - expand the amount of tables, buy better kitchenware, learn or create new recipes, fight your competition and fend off the culinary mafia all while doing your everyday chores. • A cozy simulation - the above points make you sweaty? Relax and have-a-go! Pizza Slice at its heart is a romantic and humorous depiction of what it means to run a modern restaurant business. • A portion for two - you will have your unique staff at the restaurant but why not invite a friend and play together? It’s half the buzz and double the fun! 


[hr][/hr]

🥓What can you expect from the build?


A single player experience, which will showcase the basic gameplay loop: from shopping for ingredients, through prep work, to creating pizzas, serving them and keeping your clientele satisfied. The game will allow you to play for 5 in-game days - enough to get a grasp for the mechanics and the flow of the game, while leaving an appetite for more.



The amount of available ingredients and ways in which you can expand your restaurant and your business will be limited. However, you will still be able to compose your own pizzas and set your own prices for them.



Pizza Slice continues to be in development. The current state of the build does not represent the final quality of the game.


[hr][/hr]

🌿Why are we doing the Playtest?
We strongly believe that modern games should be created alongside the game’s community. We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback about the overall enjoyment of the experience, how well the gameplay loop keeps you interested, and in which direction you would want to see the game expanding.



The playtests will help us find and resolve unforeseen issues and make the game experience tighter. If you have not been selected for this round of tests - don’t worry, you will remain in the pool of possible participants for any future playtests.

Please also bear in mind that this playtest will be a closed one, so no sharing or streaming yet - the game is still in development and not yet in a fully representative state for the general public. Thank you for respecting the embargo.

Build Information & Requirements

Platform: Windows PC via Steam

Controller Support: Partial Support

Supported Languages - VO: English, Text & Interface: ENG, FR, IT, GER, ESP, PL, PT-BR, RUS, PT, Simplified CN.

Hardware Minimum Requirements:

Windows 7 (64-bit) or newer

Intel Core i3, 3,20Ghz / AMD Phenom II X4 955, 3,2Ghz

4 GB RAM

Nvidia GeForce GTX 560 / AMD R7-260x

DirectX 11

6 GB free HDD Space



[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45047327/e00c11da06afea0c97c450539317f9ff2161465d.png"]



[hr][/hr]

🤌How to Join?[olist]
Go to the Pizza Slice Steam Page now. You can follow the link HERE.

Click on the Request Access button found on the playtest section of the page.

That’s it! You’re signed in. Now patiently await for a confirmation email.

The playtests will begin on August 26th, 2025.
[/olist]

👌Got questions?
The easiest way to ask us questions is by joining our Discord server and asking us directly.

notes.title: Tourists & star system
notes.content:
Dear ZooKeepers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/a3377ec1de5a5bc8f19703691368e83332f377ba.png

No matter how much we love animals and want to provide them with every comfort. In order to stock the zoo brilliantly with great food or attractions for the animals, funds are needed. The funds will be provided by tourists. A satisfied tourist means better care and comfort for the animals. Take care of the visitors and your Zoo will be unique.


https://i.imgur.com/7CGeEIJ.gif
Tickets and expectations
No ticket = no fun. Buy or bye. Every tourist visiting our zoo starts their adventure by buying a ticket. The price of the ticket depends on the current level of development of the zoo. To increase the level of development of the zoo, click on its gate and then use the panel that appears on the screen.
“Blessed is he who expects nothing, for he shall never be disappointed.” Every Zookeeper's problem is that tourists expect a lot. We need to meet and even exceed their expectations. Every tourist in our game has specific expectations of what they would like to see in the zoo, so it is important to take care of the diversity of species. This will allow you to meet all the expectations of visitors which brings us extra rewards.


https://i.imgur.com/iRRWG0f.gif
VIP Tourist and happenings
Every day there is a chance that a special quest will visit our zoo. The VIPs require more attention to fulfill their wishes, but they are quite wealthy, so we want them to be as happy as possible with their visit, which will lead to faster development of the zoo.
To properly prepare for a VIP visit, it would be best to have a least two different species of animals in the habitats and some infrastructure.
While playing from time to time a special quest will appear. You will need to gather a few tourists and employees in one place for a special lecture. It can be done by using drag and drop. After setting them up in the highlighted place and when the time is up, the quest will start, completing itself after a few hours. 


https://i.imgur.com/yIbHosH.gif
Star System and prestige
There are 3 star quests in each zoo. Completing them is rewarded with stars. A certain number of stars unlocks sculpture decorations, which provide permanent prestige bonuses and can be purchased almost for free.
The prestige grows with each fulfilled tourist's wish (by 1) and decreases with each unsuccessful one (by 2). The prestige level affects the number of tourists in the zoo and allows you to raise the level of the zoo center, which unlocks more expensive tickets and additional items for purchase. There is a prestige cap for each level of the zoo center. Once you reach it you can buy the next level and earn more prestige points.
The prestige adds a little challenge to the game. The more prestige you have, the more tourists will visit your zoo. 


https://i.imgur.com/zq0LysX.gif
Sculptures
In ZooKeeper, there are some hidden prizes (sculptures of the most valuable species) that you can obtain by collecting stars. Each purchased sculpture permanently raises the reputation level by 1 point. However, remember that in one zoo you can have only one sculpture of a given type. 

If you haven't already spotted it on our Steam page, we have a date for the opening of our zoo. ZooKeeper is coming in just 2 weeks on August 18th this year. Be ready!

notes.title: Zoo's finest
notes.content:
Dear ZooKeepers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/049dcc3dc2b35f8308d0bca081e3ea1b15cdaba2.png

If animals are the heart of the zoo, the personnel must be its soul. If you're determined to have a flourishing zoo, it's worth taking a moment to familiarize yourself with the possibilities ZooKeeper provides.

https://i.imgur.com/1Js5HTk.gif
Personnel management
"Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much." The better staff you hire in ZooKeeper the easier the zoo management is going to be. Employees can largely deal with the zoo on their own, but you can manage their activities by giving them personal instructions. It's easier than you think. Just right-click on the task objective and then select a command from the list.


https://i.imgur.com/bz2f6IT.gif
Levels
No one is the same, everyone is unique in their own way. Nor is everyone perfect. Every employee has their own levels, which increase when doing any activity. In the left bottom corner of the employee icon, you'll find its current level.
Clicking the employee icon will result in opening skill points distributing window. It is used to learn skills, which increase the productivity of that specific worker in many different ways. The higher the price of the employee, the more skills he has available to learn.


https://i.imgur.com/F5PhoYD.gif
Fees
If you are good at something, don't do it for free - that's a golden rule of most businesses. It is no different here. In ZooKeeper you will have a panel where you will hire, fire, and manage your employees. To open the panel just click the suitcase icon. There you can view all the information about the staff and hire them. In the case of employees, you should always pay attention to the number of paid days. If it is approaching 0, you should pay for the next with the pay button. The bonus button allows you to instantly store up energy.


https://i.imgur.com/7nu1Kup.gif
Energy
We know that energy costs are quite high these days, but we want to familiarize you with a different kind of energy - staff's energy. Every employee has an energy bar that shows their willingness to perform specific tasks. Let's take for instance the red color. It suggests that employee needs to rest. If this condition continues for a long time, they may leave their jobs or be even attacked by aggressive animals.
In order to increase the energy of your staff, you can send them to the employee yard for a break. On top of that, you can pay them bonuses that will definitely cheer them up.

Now you know a bit more about people working in the zoo. Think about how to get the most out of your employees so that they are not overworked, gushing with energy that will result in more happy visitors to your zoo.?

notes.content:
Dear ZooKeepers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/ca19655335b310af4e5e652f795babee3d965154.png

Why do we go to the zoo? To watch animals that we can't see anywhere else.
The same applies to our ZooKeeper's wild animals  It will be hard to take your eyes off our cuties. Let's begin!

https://i.imgur.com/zkOoXQU.gif
Buying animals
Remember, the most important feature of any zoo is the amazing species you can see there. You just need to press the button with the animal icon, and there you go. You have bought a new animal. Which is your favorite one?


https://i.imgur.com/ov0fc1B.gif
Statistics
Animals need care, you have to make sure that they are well-fed, entertained, clean, and healthy. Track their current statistics by just hovering the cursor over the animal.


https://i.imgur.com/7S6m4rx.gif
Aggression
Animals are wonderful, they can love, and certainly, make you smile. However, you shouldn't forget those wild instincts can be reawakened even in tamed animals, especially when they are hungry or nervous. Hungry dinosaur with a sheep in one habitat? That's probably not the best idea.


https://i.imgur.com/1UHaocd.gif
Vet
If for some reason we fail to keep an eye on all those in our care and one of the animals drops on the ground unconscious, your employees can call a vat helicopter. You should remember that in such a situation every second counts. Animals after being picked up by helicopter will have to stay with the vet for a while to get back on their feet. You can always check the progress of their treatment in the vet's panel.


https://i.imgur.com/HYZlTQN.gif
Naming
Animals can have names as well as the habitats they are staying in. Every creature is important. Make those animals unique and memorable. Just to let you know, if you click on the icon of an animal, it moves the camera over it and selects it.


Storage Room
During some renovation works, animals are not allowed to stay in their habitats. In such situations, they are sent to the storage room. When the renovation is finished remember to drag them back from the storage panel to their habitats.


https://i.imgur.com/GIIifIR.gif
Favourable Climate Conditions
Exotic animals come from different climates. Penguins like it when it's cold whereas giraffes prefer higher temperatures. You need to ensure a suitable climate in the habitats to provide them with good living conditions (and a lower rate of decline in statistics). Placing particular decorations in the habitats and painting the terrain will do the trick.

notes.title: Building your Zoo!
notes.content:
Dear ZooKeepers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/404968d78ca93a0163b8869894bdacee261e438c.png

Do you love visiting the zoo and watching wild animals? Now you get the opportunity to create the zoo of your dreams. Zookeeper gives you a lot of possibilities in the most pleasant form possible.
The release is coming soon so it would be wise to familiarise yourself with key features offered in Zookeeper! Sit back, watch and learn!

https://i.imgur.com/V6lQjns.gif
Habitats
Without habitats the are no animals, and without animals, there is no zoo. Remember to adjust the size of the habitat to the number, size, and needs of the animals living in it, also taking into account your financial possibilities. Habitats cost more the more area they cover. You can drag a fence to modify the cost. Don't forget about a staff entrance. Make your animals feel at home. 


https://i.imgur.com/tt47jJG.gif
Paths
Direct and guide your visitors. The paths are some of the most important things in the zoo. By walking the path, tourists can admire the animals and have fun with the attractions. Wake up your inner architect.


https://i.imgur.com/drVyiFY.gif
Creative Mode
The best part about being an unsupervised builder is the endless possibilities. Do you feel like creating the most bizarre homesteads? No one will limit you. Invent and create, use unlimited possibilities that the game gives you.  All operations related to changing the structure of the zoo take place in creative mode. All Shapes, colors, and sizes are at your disposal. Let your imagination run wild!


https://i.imgur.com/LY3PqKV.gif
Painting the grounds
It's time to add some colors to your animals' life. You can paint the area. By doing this, you control the climate in the habitat, which has an impact on animal well-being. Remember to adjust the climate to the appropriate animal species as it has a very strong influence on the animals. A penguin in the desert is rather a bad idea.


https://i.imgur.com/RqBELNU.gif
Decorations
Decorate zoo helps your animals feel at ease. It is worth the effort so that later you can boast to your friends about the dream place for your animals. The decorations are divided into four categories: plants, trees, rocks, and others. It's good to read a little bit about each decoration to know how it affects the climate.


https://i.imgur.com/1IVuTPC.gif
Buildings
One of the main tasks in the game is building. The buildings provide additional entertainment for tourists visiting the zoo. It is very important to provide tourists with access to a new attraction, so always make sure that the building is connected to a path.


https://i.imgur.com/rVFGuSe.gif
Bulldozer
Bulldozer is a tool that allows you to remove any item you have built. To create something, you first have to demolish something. The best way to do this would be to use, a bulldozer. You can tear down everything you had built. Note that destroying objects only returns fractions of the money spent. Don't be afraid to use it, as you can always undo changes.


https://i.imgur.com/TtjqJ6h.gif
Grid
When you turn on the grid, it appears on the ground and it makes it easier to both position and rotates the elements to be aligned with each other.

notes.title: Devlog #23: Development Progress and Best Wishes!
notes.content:
Hello, ZooKeepers! ❄️

It’s time for the last devlog of this year! Plenty of things have changed in ZooKeeper since the last update and today we’d like to tell you all about it!

Let’s start with something we were talking about in the last devlog. 

❕ Zoo selection menu – a little update

We finished adding finishing touches to the zoo zelection menu. To be specific, transition animation has been added to allow you to smoothly move from one zoo to another.

For a comparison, here is the selection menu how it appeared in the previous devlog…

https://i.imgur.com/Y3YK5yU.gif

…and here is the selection menu now! 😃

https://i.imgur.com/aJT6Lt5.gif

⭐ Have a Star!

Another thing you may recall from the last devlog is a Star rewarding system. We didn’t get to reveal much about it back then, but now we can tell you more about it! 😊

Every zoo map has 3 tasks, which reward you with Stars upon completion. ⭐⭐⭐

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/391e9be8d846585a87e2b8e408dde6bafa1fafae.png

You can review how many Stars are available on a given map from the zoo selection menu. The map’s thumbnail will tell you how many starts you already have and how many you have yet to get. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/1ed7a99a9e812fbb7f6c37add7b3b3cedff32837.png

What is the purpose of those Stars? They can be exchanged for prizes – prestigious statues you can decorate your zoo with!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/caaf0263a115b097cbb34b264894c9cd2e3577b2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/f6401aa4a1555ee87e053691fcbab3c6b5ab9e98.png

Aren’t they fancy? ✨

⚙️ More options in Settings menu

These may not as exciting news as above feature, but they’re no less important! 

We have included Camera sensitivity option in Settings menu, which allows you set the camera movements’ speed to your liking. We know each one of you has unique preferences and the default settings might not always work best – in the past, we also had trouble capturing what we wanted to show you at times due to camera moving too quickly and moving far away from our desired spot. We hope this setting will prove helpful for you as well. 🙂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/c817c886bf79b4cecbd9ea2aeed6bd0f07ce261d.png
https://i.imgur.com/fIb2idX.gif

You can also turn off chromatic aberration effect from the Settings menu if have a need for it. 

📝 End the day with an Autosave!

The title says it all – instead of saving manually all the time, the game will now be saved automatically at the end of the day. That way, you won’t need to worry about your progress and can focus on looking after animals! 💪

🔨 Get rid of multiple objects at once

There are times when you need to remove multiple objects from you zoo. Getting rid of them manually one by one might work in some cases, but it might get tedious if you have created vast flower fields or tiny forests in your zoo. That’s why we have added an option to sell multiple objects at once. When you enter Selling mode by clicking the Bulldozer icon, hold the left mouse button and expand the selection to cover all of the objects you’d like to delete. 
And...

https://i.imgur.com/UYhYJsl.gif

They’re gone!

🐘 A list of zoo animals for your convenience

A good list always comes in handy! We have improved the list of all your zoo animals. You can now sort them by enclosure, look them up by typing their name or give them their own individual names! 🤩

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/fa2683d367ac333c025067a344b8e6802fbbc6cb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/4d89bd5bc206525bfaaf514fac51ab765501cd62.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/6f10aa3cac53a11af7478bb1989362192ea2b33f.png

That’s all we’d like to share with you today. If ZooKeeper caught your interest, add the game to your Wishlist to stay up to date with development progress! As always, we also invite you to join our Discord channel!

Now, as an end note…

🎄 Merry Christmas!

We’d like to wish you a merry Christmas celebration! It may be different in different countries or even families, but it’s still a time of great importance we can spend with our families and closest ones! 😊 We hope you’ll be able to make the best use of it and enjoy it to the fullest. Rest up and get ready for a New Year!

We’ll be back with another devlog in 2022! 🙌

Stay well and take care,
ZooKeeper Team

notes.title: Devlog #22: Zoo Selection Menu
notes.content:
Hello again, ZooKeepers! 🐼

We may have been quiet for a while, but we’re as busy as ever! We’re now at a stage of constant testing, fixing and various improvements. Most of the tasks we’re handling lean on a technical side and so, they are difficult to show you in a graphical form.

The one thing we can show you, though, is the new zoo selection menu!

This is how the selection menu used to look like not long ago.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/51af665ced86367ee5666ef68122de96dc18ba41.png

You could choose the area by pressing the arrows to the left or to the right and then, you would see an overview of the currently chosen zoo. An overview included a name, a short description and a rotating view of the area.

While it had its charm, there was room for improvement. Most notably, you may notice how you can only see the area you’ve chosen. There was no way to get a glimpse of the other zoo areas other than just aimlessly clicking through every other option. It wasn’t exactly practical for that reason.

Hopefully, the text in Polish won’t bother you too much – if you’re curious, though, “Dolina Kreatywności” stands for “Creativity Valley” and that’s the name of the area you see here. 🙂

Nowadays, zoo selection menu looks like this:

https://i.imgur.com/57VBs3q.gif

As you can see, it’s much more intuitive and easier to navigate than it was before! While browsing through various locations, you’ll be able to see a glimpse of three options at once – the one that’s currently chosen, the previous one according to selection’s order, as well as the one that comes right after the chosen one. If you see an interesting location among three options visible, you can pick an area by clicking on its thumbnail, which is definitely more intuitive than having to stick to arrows all the time. 😄

How do you like it?

We are also preparing a Star awarding system, but we can’t show you it just yet, as the work is still in progress – we’ll leave details for the next devlog instead. 🙂

That’s it from us! We’ll keep working on the game to make it as relaxing and fun as possible! 💪 If ZooKeeper caught your attention, consider adding the game to your Wishlist and stay up to date with development progress! You can also join our Discord channel and talk to us about this or any other game we’re working on! 🎮

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1027810/ZooKeeper/

Thank you for your support! ❤️

Stay well,
ZooKeeper Team

notes.title: Devlog #21: VIP Visitors and more!
notes.content:
Hi there, ZooKeepers! 🐘

We apologize for the silence. We have been working hard on ZooKeeper and we did our best to keep you updated on our progress via our other social media, but we realize not all of you follow us beyond Steam. 

So, we have decided to gather all our little achievements we made since our last devlog and show them to you all here. Let’s get started!

🍦 New buildings – new attractions for your visitors

At the early stage, all you could get for your hungry visitors was a hotdog booth. Now, there is much more to choose from, as we have added ice cream, pizza, hamburger, lemonade booths and even a stand with merchandise!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/609bc9da2d8e44787547e4d37fdb57ff56e9d4d5.png

⏱️ Employees moving at the right speed 

We have tried to figure out the best way for the zoo workers to move around various enclosures. We have considered different options and admittedly, there were many difficulties along the way, but in the end, we have decided on a more simplistic solution. As long as you place a special booth in every enclosure, your employees will be able to travel between them underground by entering one enclosure, and leaving through the other, in another enclosure! Perhaps it’s not the most realistic approach, but – as we believe – it should work well with the pace of the gameplay and lowpoly aesthetic of the game. It allows the workers to move efficiently and quickly, allowing the player to relax and saving him the frustration of NPCs reacting too slowly.

https://i.imgur.com/ZkeEuYM.gif

🐣 Baby animals

That’s right! If you make sure your animal has another companion of the same species, you might find an adorable surprise in the enclosure! 

https://i.imgur.com/HE6h9Xl.gif

⭐ VIP Visitors

https://i.imgur.com/jKRhpBj.gif

As VIP part indicates, they are special individuals whose satisfaction is essential to you and your zoo’s growth. You can recognize them by a golden glow and a crown floating above their heads. Contrary to other visitors, YOU are the one who needs to control them and point them in the right direction during their visit. Unattended, they just stand idly and wait for pointers.

https://i.imgur.com/U7YMDS5.gif

You can think of them as celebrities, who expect all your attention the moment they step into your zoo. Handling them requires more effort, but it’s very much worth it! It may also be a nice change of pace compared to usual visits. 

What do you think of these additions? Let us know here or join our Discord Community and talk to us there! 💬

Thank you all for your support! ❤️ Stay tuned for upcoming updates and keep following the game on Steam!

Kind Regards,
ZooKeeper Team

notes.title: Devlog #9: Staff Members
notes.content:
Hello ZooKepers!

Let’s talk about staff members, which you can employ to take care of your animal park. 

Apart from creating your dream Zoo, you have to also manage your staff members. As a good leader, you should be aware that your staff members are not only a big help for you, but also a great responsibility. You have to properly supervise them and also remember to pay them on time.

https://i.imgur.com/fD2Mg3D.gif

Besides, you should also be aware that each staff member has a satisfaction level, responsible for the willingness to do their job. Satisfied employees perform their tasks easily. When an employee’s satisfaction level drops to zero, you’ll notice that their free will is turned off, and in this case you have to give them instructions, or let them rest for a while. 

https://i.imgur.com/VXD1Pyi.gif

What is more, each employee has one favorite task, and while doing it, the satisfaction level increases. Additionally, the satisfaction level is also connected with a staff member’s skill rank. You may observe that the satisfaction level drops slower when an employee has a high skill rank. 

https://i.imgur.com/TKDL23K.gif

Lastly, we would like to add that your awesome employees have an amazing super power. They can teleport themselves between animal enclosures, so there’s no need to wait until they finally move from one biome to another. 

https://i.imgur.com/7EUUVFD.gif

Manage your staff members properly and become the greatest ZooKeeper! Keep following the game on Steam and stay tuned for upcoming updates! If you have any questions or just want to know more about the game, feel free to join our Discord server!
